subject: maths
question: The marked price of a mobile phone at a showroom is ₹25,000 and is sold at successive discounts of 20%, 15% and 10%. Find its selling price.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the mobile phone = ₹25,000

Successive discounts = 20%, 15%, and 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount 1) × (1 - Discount 2) × (1 - Discount 3)

**Calculation:**

Marked Price = ₹25,000

Discount 1 = 20% = 0.20

Discount 2 = 15% = 0.15

Discount 3 = 10% = 0.10

⇒ Selling Price = ₹25,000 &time
s; (1 - 0.20) × (1 - 0.15) × (1 - 0.10)

⇒ Selling Price = ₹25,000 × 0.80 × 0.85 × 0.90

⇒ Selling Price = ₹25,000 × 0.612

⇒ Selling Price = ₹15,300

**The selling price of the mobile phone is ₹15,300.**
